groups.sentence: Employees and meeting participants promptly report AI concerns, problems, or issues to the host, IT, or the designated office.
Instructors report discrepancies or issues with AI tools to IIT or the University AI Committee.
Everyone immediately reports suspected data breaches, security incidents, or unauthorized disclosure of sensitive data involving AI tools to the designated office.
Everyone reports suspected security issues, misuse, or ethical and compliance concerns about AI use through proper university channels.
Everyone reports conduct that violates AI policy, and failing to report a known violation is itself a violation.
Administrators provide channels for reporting, complaints and redress, and receive and review the reports.
Administrators activate incident response, document and investigate incidents, notify affected parties and regulators, and refer violations to proper bodies.
Students report unethical AI use or AI misinformation and hallucinations to their instructor or supervisor.
Students may need to take further action together with their instructor or supervisor after reporting.
Researchers report adverse events or unanticipated problems to the IRB.
Anyone may report AI-related risks, issues, or concerns through a university form, anonymous tool, or office.
Users report AI tool malfunctions, vulnerabilities, or performance and accuracy problems to the designated office or incident database.
